physical.mounting-hardware: Hex bolt x3, nut x3, washer x6 and split washer x3 (instruction sheet)

base.description: The manager as APC ships AR8665, its door fitted.

doors-off.description: The same manager with its door taken off, the finger columns and the channel open to lay a cable in. The door comes with the manager, so this is an illustration and not a device type.

datasheet.title: Performance, Vertical Cable Manager for 2 & 4 Post Racks, 84"H x 12"W, Single-Sided with Door (AR8665), product data sheet

description: Single-sided vertical cable manager, 12 in wide, APC Performance AR8665 for 2 and 4 post open frame racks: a steel back plate 2134 mm tall with a column of 44 smooth plastic fingers down each side of one cable channel, a finger to each rack unit, and a full-length door with two quarter-turn latches that ships fitted. It stands beside the rack on three hex bolts through the upright and takes no rack unit.

gaps.note: the door "opens to left or right" on hinge pins and lifts off; no view dimensions a hinge. The door is drawn as one fitted plate that is either on or off.
gaps.wanted: a drawing or a close render of the door's hinge pins and latch

gaps.note: the data sheet advertises "multiple internal cable tie-off locations"; the instruction sheet draws the back plate's slots but dimensions none, and the format has no place to state a tie point on a duct (#1009 states them only on the FS tray). They are not drawn or stated.
gaps.wanted: the back plate's slots dimensioned, and a place in the format for a duct's tie points

gaps.note: the instruction sheet shows an optional grounding and bonding point, a tab with a hole, "Hardware and cable not provided". No thread or hole size is stated, and a grounding point in the format is a stud or screw with a thread, so none is stated.
gaps.wanted: the size of the hole and the screw it takes

gaps.note: APC states "high capacity" and no figure on the data sheet, the instruction sheet or the brochure, so none is recorded and none is estimated.
gaps.wanted: a capacity figure and the cable it is stated for

gaps.note: the instruction sheet's figure draws each finger as a smooth tongue with a rolled root; it is built as an arm 12 across and a hooked tip 22 across, 31 high, 296 long, and the 44 are counted, none of it dimensioned. The figure is of the single-sided part at one width.
gaps.wanted: a section through a finger and the back plate

gaps.note: where the first finger stands against the rack's units is not stated; the fingers are centred on the 2134 mm height and whether they sit on the rack's units is not known.
gaps.wanted: the heights of the three bolt holes against the rack's first unit

gaps.note: the back plate takes the AR8652 spacer bracket and the accessory brackets, sold separately; they are other parts and are not drawn.
gaps.wanted: the accessory parts, if they are modelled

gaps.note: the door has an oval opening near its top in the instruction sheet's figure; it is not drawn.
how far the manager stands from the upright when bolted on is not dimensioned; the part is drawn alone.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of the manager fitted to an upright

body.description: the back plate and its well

fingers.description: the sections of 11 fingers, left then right, top to bottom

name: ar8665

attrs.note: datasheet - the colour, the plastic fingers, the hardware, the provided doors and installation guide, UL Listed and EU RoHS compliant are the data sheet and the instruction sheet.

capacity.note: datasheet - the AR8665 data sheet and the brochure state no cable capacity. None is estimated.

chassis.note: datasheet - 304 x 2134 x 360, door fitted: "Width 12.0 in (304 mm)", "Height 84.02 in (2134 mm)", "Depth 14.2 in (360 mm)".

color.note: estimated - "Color: Black"; every image APC publishes is a render, so it is drawn black.

depth.note: estimated - the 360 is the data sheet's, drawn as a 60 back plate zone and a 300 well (see ar8615).

front.note: estimated - the working face with the door fitted, placed as the AR8615's with the right finger column at 276: the door, and under it the back plate with 44 fingers a side in four sections of 11. The `duct` guide is the 248 between the finger columns.

guides.note: estimated - the channel between the two finger columns, run down the height (`run: y`); pitch the rack unit, 44.45, as the data sheet's "1U increments", gap the pitch less the 31 mm finger, 13.45.

left.note: estimated - the back plate and the finger zone along it, as the AR8615's.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN DOCUMENTS, read as the AR8615's are (see ar8615): the AR8665 data sheet, the instruction sheet 990-4576A-001 and the brochure. THE FIGURES THE DATA SHEET PRINTS ARE `datasheet`; EVERYTHING READ OFF THE INSTRUCTION SHEET'S FIGURES IS ESTIMATED and said so in the part that carries it. No drawing or photograph is copied.

mount.note: datasheet - `rack-side`, as the AR8615 (see ar8615): "Mounting Mode: Not rack-mountable" on the data sheet, bolted to the side of the upright by the instruction sheet's three hex bolts. It occupies no rack unit. `ru: 44` is the rack height it runs beside, the fingers' 44 units: the height of the AR203A and one short of the AR201's 45, so one figure places it beside either (lint L154 judges a part by `ru`; the 2134 mm of the data sheet is the whole part). Which side of the rack is a lab placement to say.

rear.note: estimated - the back plate, the face that stands against the rack's upright; drawn plain (see ar8615).

right.note: estimated - the left view turned round.

shell.note: estimated - A HOLLOW CHANNEL, NOT A BOX (see ar8615): a sheet body whose solid is the well, the 88 fingers standing off its floor and the door over their tips.

thickness.note: estimated - no APC document states a gauge; 1.5 is a sheet of this kind.

top.note: estimated - the plan, rear at y=0, as the AR8615's at this width.

weight.note: datasheet - "Net Weight 67.02 lb(US) (30.4 kg)"; packed 36.3 kg.
